stories.title: The Map Mystery of the Museum

The evidence gave the team a testable explanation rather than another suspicion.

The timeline showed how both witnesses had seen different stages of the same event: the apparent sabotage was actually an emergency signal. A forgotten maintenance gate could protect both homes and wildlife. The missing detail reconciled the conflicting accounts. This explained the original mystery rather than introducing a new one. The team compared this explanation with the original evidence. a river otter checked the clue again and found that it fit the evidence gathered at the start.

With the cause understood, a river otter opened the hidden channel and restored the town's water. The community saw how the evidence led to the solution and prevented the next scheduled outage. The team published a shared timeline so future warnings could be interpreted correctly. Together they opened a safe passage and installed a seasonal gate inspection. The witness was invited to help document the corrected record.
